# Murikah

> Assurance. Systems. Intelligence. Pronounced moo-REE-kah, rhymes with Eureka.

Murikah provides internal audit services and Assurance OS for regulated teams in Kenya and East Africa. The website explains the services, publishes software pricing ranges and offers a browser-only sandbox using fictional data. Work is aligned to IIA Standards, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001; this is not a claim of accreditation or endorsement.

## Assurance OS and services

- Assurance OS: audit plans, work papers, review, findings, actions and committee reporting. Published pricing starts at KES 15,000 per month. https://murikah.com/assurance-os
- Public sandbox: explore fictional audit records without sign-in. https://murikah.com/assurance-os/sandbox
- Sign in to Assurance OS: https://grc.murikah.com
- Internal audit: co-sourced and outsourced internal audit, systems and IT audits, data protection reviews, and AI-governance readiness. https://murikah.com/internal-audit
- Automation: workflow automation and internal tools. https://murikah.com/automation
- Advisory: AI strategy, governance roadmaps, analytics and board papers. https://murikah.com/advisory
- Training: CISA preparation, ISO 42001 awareness and lead-auditor readiness. Contact Murikah for dates and availability. https://murikah.com/training

## Research

Research is accessible through Insights. Benchmarking and an annual report are forthcoming; no benchmark figures have been published. https://murikah.com/research

## Standards and proof

Murikah aligns audit work to IIA Standards, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001. A redacted report extract shows results from earlier audit work with client details removed: https://murikah.com/proof/report-extract

## Who it is for

Heads of internal audit, audit committee and board chairs, CFOs, CEOs, and heads of risk and compliance at regulated mid-market organisations. Priority audience pages:
- SACCOs: https://murikah.com/saccos
- Banks and microfinance institutions: https://murikah.com/banks

The wider audience also includes fintechs, donor-funded NGOs and family-owned businesses with active boards.

## Standards the work follows

Murikah works to the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards for its internal audit work, and to the ISO/IEC 27001 standard for information security and the ISO/IEC 42001 standard for AI management systems, which it audits against and helps clients prepare for. These are the standards the company works to and helps clients with, not certifications the company holds.
